news.hero.title: Exhibition News
news.hero.subtitle: Get the latest expo updates, industry news, and company announcements
newsdetail.article1.p1: The first batch of exhibitor list for IFSIE 2026 has been officially announced. More than 1200 companies from home and abroad have registered, covering six major areas: fitness equipment, sports tech & smart wearables, sports apparel & gear, sports nutrition & health foods, wellness & rehab equipment, and outdoor & extreme sports. Industry leaders will all be present.
newsdetail.article1.p2: Among the first confirmed exhibitors are both long-standing leading brands and innovative companies rising fast in new tracks such as smart fitness and smart sports. The organizing committee noted that the lineup will continue to grow as the expo approaches.
newsdetail.article2.p1: With the rapid development of AI technology, smart fitness equipment is becoming a new industry hotspot. This edition will showcase AI fitness coaches, smart body-composition analyzers, VR immersive training systems, and data-driven sports management platforms.
newsdetail.article2.p2: Many exhibitors said smart fitness products have moved from concept to mature implementation, significantly improving workout efficiency and experience. A smart fitness new-product launch event will also be held during the expo.
newsdetail.article3.p1: To facilitate professional buyers, the organizing committee has opened a pre-registration channel. Pre-registered visitors enjoy VIP services including a dedicated fast entry, priority booking of business matching areas, expo kits, and one-on-one procurement matching.
newsdetail.article3.p2: Buyers who complete pre-registration before the expo also receive the e-catalog and exhibitor directory for free, helping them plan their visit in advance.
newsdetail.article4.p1: Three theme forums will be held concurrently during the expo: the Fitness & Sports Industry Development Summit, the Digital Transformation & Smart Sports Forum, and the Industry Trends Release & Policy Interpretation. They bring together authoritative experts, renowned business leaders, and policy research representatives for in-depth dialogue on industry trends, technological innovation, and policy direction.
newsdetail.article4.p2: The forums will focus on innovative applications of AI, big data, and IoT in sports, authoritatively interpret industry policies, and release the latest industry development trend reports, providing participants with forward-looking insights and decision-making references, and building an efficient exchange platform for industry, academia, research, and application.
newsdetail.article5.p1: The zone plan for the 2026 IFSIE has been officially released. The expo features six themed zones: Fitness Equipment, Sports Tech & Smart Wearables, Sports Apparel & Gear, Sports Nutrition & Health Foods, Wellness & Rehab Equipment, and Outdoor & Extreme Sports, comprehensively covering the entire fitness & sports industry chain.
newsdetail.article5.p2: The six zones are scientifically planned according to industry-chain logic, achieving complementary categories and synergistic impact to provide professional visitors with a one-stop sourcing and exchange experience across the entire fitness & sports industry chain.
newsdetail.article6.p1: As a brand-new first edition, exhibitors at IFSIE 2026 enjoy a special 60% incubation-period policy premium, substantially lowering investment costs and boosting exhibitor ROI. The expo is also supported by the Tianjin Convention & Exhibition Industry Development Regulations and dedicated funding, ensuring a sound policy guarantee system.
newsdetail.article6.p2: Booths come in three specifications — standard booth (9 sqm, ¥10,800/booth), raw space (from 36 sqm, ¥1,180/sqm), and discounted raw space for startups and association-recommended companies (¥980/sqm) — meeting the exhibiting needs of enterprises of different sizes. Domestic and overseas enterprises are welcome to register.

guidepage.map.title: Venue Info
guidepage.map.name: National Convention and Exhibition Center (Tianjin)
guidepage.map.addr: No. 888, Guozhan Avenue, Jinnan District, Tianjin
guidepage.venue.feature1.title: Massive Scale
guidepage.venue.feature1.desc: Total building area of 1.34 million sqm, indoor exhibition area of 400,000 sqm, the largest exhibition complex in northern China
guidepage.venue.feature2.title: Green & Smart
guidepage.venue.feature2.desc: Integrates 88 green energy-saving technologies with full 5G coverage for smart and low-carbon venue operations
guidepage.venue.feature3.title: Column-Free Space
guidepage.venue.feature3.desc: Hall ceiling height of 16m, floor load capacity of 4-5 tons/sqm, perfectly suited for heavy machinery and large exhibits
guidepage.venue.feature4.title: Convenient Transport
guidepage.venue.feature4.desc: Metro Line 1 directly reaches the venue, equipped with 110,000 sqm freight waiting area and 10,000 parking spaces
guidepage.venue.feature5.title: Premium Conference Facilities
guidepage.venue.feature5.desc: Features a 3,200 sqm multifunctional hall and a 2,882 sqm grand conference hall, meeting diverse high-end conference and event needs
guidepage.transport.title: Transportation
guidepage.transport.item1.title: By Metro
guidepage.transport.item1.desc: Take Metro Line 1 to National Exhibition Center Station, Exit B leads directly to the venue (about 5 minutes on foot).
guidepage.transport.item2.title: By High-Speed Rail
guidepage.transport.item2.desc: From Tianjin Station, take Line 3 and transfer to Line 1 (about 40 min). From Tianjin West Station, Line 1 goes directly.
guidepage.transport.item3.title: By Air
guidepage.transport.item3.desc: From Tianjin Binhai International Airport, take Line 2 and transfer to Line 1 (about 1 hour), or take the airport shuttle or taxi.
guidepage.transport.item4.title: By Car
guidepage.transport.item4.desc: Navigate to the National Convention and Exhibition Center (Tianjin). A large underground parking lot is available.
guidepage.hotel.title: Hotels
guidepage.hotel.desc: Recommended hotels near the venue. Prices are for reference only.
guidepage.hotel.item1.name: InterContinental Tianjin (Convention Center)
guidepage.hotel.item1.desc: 0.5 km from the venue, ideal for business travel; special rates available via the committee.
guidepage.hotel.item2.name: Atour Hotel (Guozhan Avenue)
guidepage.hotel.item2.desc: 1.2 km from the venue, great value, within walking distance.
guidepage.hotel.item3.name: Tianjin Jinnan Hengjing Hotel
guidepage.hotel.item3.desc: 2 km from the venue, breakfast included, with plenty of dining options nearby.

guidepage.exhibit.item1.title: Move-In & Setup
guidepage.exhibit.item1.desc: Oct 12-14, 08:00-18:00. Enter with your exhibitor badge and booth confirmation.
guidepage.exhibit.item2.title: Move-Out
guidepage.exhibit.item2.desc: Move-out starts after 16:00 on Oct 17. Arrange logistics in advance.
guidepage.exhibit.item3.title: Exhibit Logistics
guidepage.exhibit.item3.desc: Designated logistics providers offer goods collection and storage. Book in advance.
guidepage.exhibit.item4.title: On-Site Services
guidepage.exhibit.item4.desc: Information desk, medical point, business center, and dining areas are available in the halls.
guidepage.faq.title: FAQ
guidepage.faq.q1: How do I get a free ticket?
guidepage.faq.a1: Register online in advance for free entry. Verify on site with your QR code or ID.
guidepage.faq.a2: Yes, scan to register at the venue. Online registration is recommended to save time.
guidepage.faq.a3: Yes, accompanied by an adult and subject to on-site safety rules.
guidepage.faq.q4: Is photography allowed in the halls?
guidepage.faq.a4: Yes, but please follow exhibitors' requirements. Do not photograph exhibits involving trade secrets.

coop.pricing.standard.title: Standard Booth
coop.pricing.standard.spec: 9sqm (3m×3m) | Includes fascia board, one table, two chairs, spotlight, and power
coop.pricing.rawspace.title: Raw Space
coop.pricing.rawspace.spec: From 36sqm | No fixtures, suitable for custom booth construction
coop.pricing.discount.title: Discounted Raw Space
coop.pricing.discount.spec: From 36sqm | For startups and association-recommended companies, with exclusive subsidy
coop.pricing.note: Note: Double-open booths incur an additional 10% charge; all prices are pre-tax; standard booth meets basic display needs; raw space requires self-managed construction and venue reporting. Inaugural edition enjoys a 60% special policy premium.
coop.process.title: Exhibition Process
coop.process.step1: 1. Application: Submit exhibition application form and company qualifications
coop.process.step2: 2. Qualification Review: Organizer reviews exhibitor qualifications
coop.process.step3: 3. Booth Confirmation: Confirm booth location and area upon approval
coop.process.step4: 4. Contract Signing: Sign exhibition contract and pay deposit
coop.process.step5: 5. Payment: Pay exhibition fees as per contract terms
coop.process.step6: 6. Preparation: Prepare exhibits, promotional materials, and staff
coop.process.step7: 7. Setup: Enter venue for booth construction during designated time
coop.process.step8: 8. Exhibition: Normal exhibition during show days
coop.process.step9: 9. Dismantling: Dismantle booth after the exhibition concludes
